issue: models/asr/qwen-aligner/model.safetensors was a 100%-zero placeholder of the correct size
detected_by: workflow_align -> T8DramaAlign -> SafetensorError: Error while deserializing header: invalid JSON in header: EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 0
why_it_missed_the_sha256_pass: upstream model-manifest.json gives qwen-aligner/model.safetensors a byte count but no sha256, so the acceptance sweep had nothing to compare it against
root_cause: hf_hub_download(local_dir=...) left the payload in local_dir/.cache/huggingface/... and the cache was removed afterwards, leaving a same-size empty shell

repair.method: deployment/_parallel_download.py, 64 workers x 8 MiB ranges (its 'already_present' check treats an all-zero chunk as NOT downloaded, so no zero chunk is trusted)
repair.sha256_source: HF LFS metadata lfs.oid for the LFS-backed file (verified byte-for-byte against the downloaded file)

also_restored: models/asr/qwen-aligner/download-revision.json (106 B) - upstream manifest lists it, it was never on disk
models/asr/qwen-aligner/README.md (57456 B) - upstream manifest lists it, it was never on disk
